'''Tomato soup''' is a [[soup]] with [[tomato]]es as the primary ingredient. It can be served hot or [[cold]], and may be made in a variety of ways.<ref name=variety>{{cite book|last=Herbig|first=Paul A.|title=Handbook of Cross-Cultural Marketing|year=1998|publisher=International Business Press|location=Binghamton, NY|isbn=978-0789001542|page=[https://archive.org/details/handbookofcrossc0000herb/page/45 45]|quote=Irish and Italians prefer creamy tomato soup, Germans want rice, and Colombians want spice.|url=https://archive.org/details/handbookofcrossc0000herb/page/45}}</ref>  It may be smooth in texture, and there are also recipes that include chunks of tomato, [[cream]], [[chicken]] or [[vegetable]] [[Stock (food)|stock]], [[vermicelli]], chunks of other vegetables and meatballs. Many countries have their own versions of tomato soup which all vary in taste, portions and ingredients.
